notes.title: - Patch Note V0.2 -
notes.notes:
[h3]Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Menu
[*] Added the new map ICE with Icy being redesigned
[*] Added a Timer before the Sudden Death
[*] Added new settings (game language and audio system)
[*] Actually you may have some problem if you change your language, we are already working on it.
[*] PENGUINS
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bomb explosion effects
[*] Fixed the Game Over screen (not finished yet, just a placeholder)
[*] Fixed the bomb explosion speed (before and after the explosion)
[*] Fixed the broken zoom when players are near each other (one more time)
[*] Menu is partially controllable by the controller (we still have some problems with the menu but it should be fixed in the next update)
[/list]

notes.title: Ice is finally here
notes.notes:
Hi Bomber, we’re finally back and we are happy to introduce you our new map: Ice

Icy is happy to introduce you her own map located somewhere in Antarctica accompanied by her friends the penguins.
With this addition, we are uploading a new patch, the V0.2. (Patch Notes coming soon)

Don’t worry, new maps and new characters are coming soon on Bomber League, more info soon!

End of transmission.

notes.title: WELCOME!
notes.notes:
Welcome Bomber, nice to meet you! Happy to see you here, you have been chosen to test our still closed arena directly in the League.

Why is it closed? Because the constructions aren’t finished, but don’t worry, you are not in danger, everything is working correctly and you are safe! How is it working you will ask, it’s simple join us on Discord were we will drop some keys, with this key you will have acess to the arena. As we said, the League is under constructions, so there may be some problems.

 

If it is the case do not hesitate to contact us directly on Steam, our Support or on Discord, our engineers will fix it as soon as possible. See you soon, good luck and good fight, Bomber.

End of transmission.
